discover.title: Find your module
discover.hint: Plug the module in and hold its BOOT button for 3 seconds until the light blinks. Then press “Find module” and pick it in the browser window.
discover.unsupported: This browser cannot connect over Bluetooth. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer, or Chrome on Android.
discover.portalFallback: Alternative: join the “EnergyMonitor-Setup” Wi-Fi network (the portal password set in the firmware), open http://192.168.4.1 and set the network there.
discover.linuxFlag: Chrome on Linux ships with Web Bluetooth turned off. Open this address in a new tab, set “Experimental Web Platform features” to Enabled, press “Relaunch” and open this window again:

appliance.hint: Select the type of appliance that will be connected to this module

network.title: Connect to your WiFi network
network.subtitle: These are the networks the module can see. Pick your home network.

connecting.step0: Registering the device in your home

errors.bluetooth: The Bluetooth connection to the module was lost. Move closer and try again.
errors.wifiNotFound: The module cannot find that network. Check the name or move it closer to the router.
errors.wifiFailed: The module could not join the Wi-Fi network.
errors.broker: The module has Wi-Fi but cannot reach the server.
errors.timeout: The module did not answer in time. Check it is still on and nearby.
errors.noBroker: The server has no MQTT broker address configured (DEVICE_MQTT_PUBLIC_HOST).

reconnect.title: Change Wi-Fi of “{{name}}”
reconnect.hint: Use it if you moved, changed the Wi-Fi password or your internet provider. If the module cannot find its network it turns Bluetooth on by itself after 5 minutes; to skip the wait, hold its BOOT button for 3 seconds until the light blinks. Then press “Find module” and pick “EnergyMonitor-{{code}}”.
reconnect.wrongModule: That is module {{found}}, not {{code}}. Pick “EnergyMonitor-{{code}}” in the browser window.

edit.title: Edit device
edit.hint: Change which appliance this module measures, its name or its location. The module stays connected.
